current_truth_evidence.summary: Installed CLI 0.164.0-alpha.11.1 with isolated HOME and mock provider: delete/archive both emit SessionEnd while original source still exists, then remove/move it; unsubscribe retains source. Zero real model calls; desktop button not tested.

Fruit-fly-only read-only audit:22 indexed segments/8 chats,3 chats have all registered files missing while allowlist roots remain accessible (_all_missing returns None). They retain208 work records,61 v2 nodes, no cleanup marker; cause/time of these old omissions not established. No actual chat/data deletion or historical sweep. Attempted native chat-filtered work-map read timed out and is not counted as live UI/recall acceptance.

Installed Codex 0.164.0-alpha.11.1: unarchive/read/delete emits no SessionEnd. Installed observer plus simulated renderer tombstone cleans actual fixture SQLite; zero real model calls and no foreign-key errors. Vnode tests cover in-place/atomic state writes, singleton, shared support, present/unavailable sources, backend rows, project disable and global uninstall. Runtime suite1406 passed before final global-disable guard; final focused95 tests passed; frontend95 passed. Initial root-cwd runs had harness import/registration failures; runtime-cwd isolated rerun passed. Signed app and immutable runtime ccdc1eae358d45501aa6 installed; all4 changed runtime modules match source. Fruit-fly observer running on that immutable source, kernel wait/no polling. Production targeted repair removed only confirmed deleted chat01a11ac0's147 legacy memories/1401 entries/3 segments. Every other chat's memory count and v2 totals30238/12304/95865 unchanged. No historical sweep. Renderer persistence was simulated in isolated smoke, not desktop-button E2E.

Installed running-desktop backend codex-cli0.164.0-alpha.11.1, isolated HOME, existing reviewed recorder Hook, localhost mock provider only: active and unsubscribed delete/archive emit SessionEnd while source still exists; unsubscribe preserves source. After backend restart, deleting/archiving a never-reloaded persisted fixture removes/moves source with NO SessionEnd. No real-model calls, production chat deletion, trust hash edits or desktop-button E2E. This proves a missing trigger independent of uncertain removal timing.

architecture_decisions.statement: Use missing registered sources as cleanup policy, not as proof of Codex permanent deletion
architecture_decisions.rationale: User explicitly accepts archive and delete as equivalent for graph cleanup

architecture_decisions.statement: Resolve an absent project cleanup option from the enabled global registration at execution time
architecture_decisions.rationale: User requested enablement for all projects. Dynamic inheritance covers old and new projects without config fanout, registry scans or historical deletion; explicit local booleans remain authoritative.

architecture_decisions.statement: Use new desktop deletion markers only as triggers; require an absent backend thread row and all registered sources missing before reusing transactional cleanup
architecture_decisions.rationale: Reading history is not resuming a runtime. One singleton per active project waits in kqueue without periodic scans, skips startup history, and retains one bounded diagnostic receipt. No Hook trust or desktop installation is modified.

residual_items.description: One delayed check deliberately has no retries. If source removal takes longer than two seconds, cleanup is conservatively skipped; existing backups are not securely erased.
residual_items.mitigation: Preserve on timing uncertainty; isolated installed-CLI timing verified. Backups remain outside the graph cleanup contract.
residual_items.exit_condition: Keep low-energy one-shot policy; reopen only with observed missed-event evidence

residual_items.description: Deletion before any observer starts after backend restart is explicitly excluded by the user. New permanent deletions while the observer is active no longer require SessionEnd. Historical missing chats are not swept.
residual_items.exit_condition: Reopen only if the user expands the supported startup boundary.
residual_items.mitigation: Observer startup snapshots existing tombstones without replay. Only the specifically confirmed production deletion was reconciled.

residual_items.description: Desktop deletion-marker keys and state_5.sqlite are version-specific private integration points.
residual_items.exit_condition: Revalidate on Codex format changes or replace with a supported deletion event when available.
residual_items.mitigation: Fail closed on invalid/missing/oversized state, retain SessionEnd fallback, and require backend absence plus registered-source checks. Never treat a marker alone as erasure authority.
